recent_excerpts: Criminal IP and Securonix ThreatQ partnership embeds exposure-based threat intel into automated workflows, reducing manual triage for SOC teams.
Black Hills Information Security released GoSpoof, a Python tool that opens all ports on a honeypot to capture attacker scanning patterns and payloads in real time.
Insikt Group details four blind spots in AI adoption for threat intel: comprehension gaps, eroding moats, deployment complexity, and shifting senior roles.
